main_text.p: Præf.4.&c. de Mozdar. Ǫ[?]rinx addidit Mozdarus, recensét Sharestanius, scil. إبطال إعجاز القران من جهة الفصاحة والبلاغة quod nullum in Alcorano miraculum agnosceret respectu eloquentiæ & elegantiæ. At non ille primus vel solus in hac sententia fuit. Idem asseruit AlNodhamus, referentibus iisdem, scil. quod ad إعجاز القران seu illud quod in Alcorano pro miraculo habendum انه من حيث الاخبار عن الامور الماضية والآتية ومن جهة صرف الدواعي عن المعارضة ومنع العرب عن الاهتمام به جيرا وتعجيزا ان لو خلاهم لكانوا قادرين علي ان ياتوا بسورة من مثله بلاغة Esse respectu narrationum quæ in eo habentur, de rebus præteritis & futuris, & respectu aversionis [seu quòd averteret Deus illos] qui illud sibi arrogarent, ne cum eo [eloquentia scil.] contenderent, & potenter cohibuerit Arabes quo minus illud in animum inducerent, cùm si illos sinvisset, potuissent certè proferre caput aliquod ei elegantiâ, eloquentiâ & compositionis venustate par. Verba sunt AlSharestanii, sic & Author AlMamakes, Dixit, (inquit) AlNoddham صرفهم عنها مع قدرتهم Aversit ab hoc eos [Deus] cùm illud aliàs facere potuissent. Inter varias autem Mohammedanorum de Alcorano suo sententias, minimè prætereySub Almotasa-mo et AlMota-waccelo Chalifis floruit.unda est illa AlJahedhi (sectæ AlJahedhianorum patris ac seste Sharestanio) من فضلاء المعتزلة والمصنف è clarissimis Motazalorum, multarumque librorum authoris, scil. ان القران جسن يجوز ان يقلب مرة رجلا ومرة حيوانا Esse Alcoranum corpus quod converti

page.notes: The first word has a large decorative initial that I could not identify with confidence; it is marked [?]. The Arabic text is my best reading of a small, partly worn print. Individual Arabic letters and diacritics may be wrong and are not marked in every case. The marginal note "Sub Almotasa-mo" is placed beside the line where it stands on the scan. The word "praetereunda" is broken at the line end as printed, and I have kept the reading "præterey" with a hyphen-free join; the printed break may be "praeter-" + "eunda", so please check that join. The catchword "converti" stands alone at the right below the last full line.
